claim: Random sampling estimates population risk more accurately than deterministic uncertainty-top selection.
Risk-stratified proportional sampling reduces MSE relative to simple random sampling at equal labels.
Equal-across-risk-strata allocation improves on proportional allocation for population risk.
Augmented IPW reduces MSE relative to IPW with identical PPS queries and known propensities.
Self-normalized Hajek ratio reduces MSE relative to unbiased Horvitz-Thompson on same queried set.
